mapper.select: /*checkMasterMdCtCustomerInfo*/ SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.IRS_NO),0,'N','Y') AS RESULT_YN FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST A WHERE REPLACE(A.IRS_NO,'-','') = REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-','')

/* selectCustomerInfo */ SELECT X.IRS_NO ,X.YYYY ,X.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME ,X.CEO_NAME_LOC ,X.CONGLOMERATE AS GROUP_NAME ,X.CREDIT_RATING ,X.YEAR_AMT AS SALES_AMT ,X.EMP_CNT AS EMPLOYEE_CNT ,X.INDUSTRY_CODE AS INDUSTRY_TYPE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'CP13' AND CODE = X.INDUSTRY_CODE) AS INDUSTRY_NAME ,X.TEL_NO ,X.ADDRESS_LOC AS HEAD_ADDRESS_LOC ,TO_CHAR(X.ADD_DATETIME, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE ,X.ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM ,TO_CHAR(X.CHANGE_DATETIME, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE ,X.CHANGE_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM , #{st_session_id} AS KEP_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{st_session_id}) AS KEP_USER_NM , (SELECT USR.DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{st_session_id}) AS KEP_USER_DEPT , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMLUSR USR, ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.COMPANY_CODE = USR.COM_CODE AND COD.TYPE = 'C001' AND USR.USER_ID = #{st_session_id} AND USR.DEPARTMENT = COD.CODE ) AS KEP_USER_DEPT_NM FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST X WHERE X.IRS_NO =#{st_irs_no}

/*selectMasterMdCdCpAddrNextcodeVal*/
SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(CODE1)) +1,'1') FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO} ,'-',''),0,3)||'-'||SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-',''),4,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-',''),6,5) AND TYPE = 'CP_ADDR'
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCtCustomerInfoCpAddr */ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD3 ( BUYER ,TYPE ,CODE1 ,CODE2 ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 ,TEXT3 ,TEXT4 ,VALUE1 ,FLAG ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_DATE )VALUES ( SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO} ,'-',''),0,3)||'-'||SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-',''),4,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-',''),6,5) ,'CP_ADDR' ,#{nextCodeVal} ,'본사' ,#{ADDRESS_LOC} ,'' ,'' ,'' ,'' ,'Y' ,#{st_user_id} ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )
